context.problem_statement: Perform market basket analysis using the Apriori algorithm on transaction data. Find all association rules with minimum support = 0.25 and minimum confidence = 0.6. For each rule, compute support, confidence, and lift. Report: (1) top 5 rules by lift, (2) all rules with lift > 1.5 (positive association), (3) any rules where lift < 1 (negative association). Format each rule as '{antecedent} -> {consequent}: support=X, confidence=Y, lift=Z'.
context.expert_knowledge: Support(A->B) = P(A and B) = count(A,B)/total_transactions. Confidence(A->B) = P(B|A) = count(A,B)/count(A). Lift(A->B) = Confidence(A->B)/Support(B) = P(A,B)/(P(A)*P(B)). Lift > 1: positive association, < 1: negative association. Use mlxtend.frequent_patterns.apriori and association_rules. Transform transactions to one-hot encoded matrix before running.
